purpose: Continue the active three-session factor goal from Campaign144 without waiting for a new daily bar, while rejecting exposed operator refreshes before any Campaign145 source or research value is read.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_amount_cumulative_path_signed_area_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Within each fixed half-session, compare the ordering of cumulative signed return innovation and cumulative transaction-amount arrival through one oriented path area, then average the two half-session areas.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: This is a global ordered path-geometry statistic. It is neither a pointwise dependence coefficient, an unsigned distribution-alignment score, an amount-clock summary, a crossing count, nor a complete-library combination.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_amount_cumulative_path_absolute_area_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Discard the orientation of the same cumulative return-amount path area.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Absolute area is an alternate direction-destroying transform inside the selected mechanism and would create a post-selection sibling search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_cumulative_return_amount_path_loop_count_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Count crossings or loops after thresholding the same two cumulative paths.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Threshold and crossing choices are researcher degrees of freedom and approach Candidate49's frozen cumulative-crossing family without an independent observation domain.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_range_amount_cumulative_path_signed_area_240m

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: This is a functional refresh of the terminal range-amount alignment, timing and profile families.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_volume_cumulative_path_signed_area_238p

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Volume versus amount is an alternate activity-field choice inside one mechanism; only transaction amount is selected before values.
